infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nicholasfit uses the camera to photograph meals and scan barcodes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nicholasfit lets you pick a meal photo to estimate calories.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nicholasfit does not record audio, but iOS asks when the camera opens.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Nicholasfit reads your sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, steps and rowing workouts so your weekly coaching can account for recovery.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Nicholasfit saves your strength workouts and heart rate to Apple Health.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Nicholasfit connects to your heart rate strap to show your heart rate during workouts.
